groups.label: Design
groups.description: The craft of making complex information feel simple, useful, and human.

groups.label: Development
groups.description: Front-end implementation with a bias for clarity, accessibility, and speed.

workflow.title: Understand
workflow.description: Talk to the people who use the thing, read the content, and map the constraints.

workflow.title: Frame
workflow.description: Write the brief, define the information architecture, and choose the smallest useful scope.

workflow.title: Explore
workflow.description: Sketch broadly, prototype early, and test the interaction model before polishing pixels.

workflow.title: Refine
workflow.description: Build the system, check the edge cases, and make accessibility part of the definition of done.

workflow.title: Ship
workflow.description: Launch with documentation, a performance check, and a clear plan for what happens next.
